items.name: BGP
items.explanation: The routing protocol the networks of the internet use to tell each other which addresses they can reach. Anycast relies on it: the same address is announced from many places and BGP's choices decide where each packet lands.

assumedBy.quote: Anycast is the easiest loadbalancing method that relies on the core internet routing protocol, BGP.

items.name: Envoy and xDS
items.explanation: Envoy is a proxy that can be configured while it runs. Its xDS discovery services let a management server push resources such as routes and cluster weights to it, which is how a drain can be applied without restarting anything.

assumedBy.quote: all our edge load balancers are now running Envoy and receive configuration from Rotor, our in-house xDS control plane.
